column_description: A SERIAL primary key uniquely identifying each thermal/solar/wind/grid record.
A VARCHAR(70) foreign key referencing Equipment(EquipmentCode), linking this record to a piece of equipment that manages thermal or power generation.
An INTEGER foreign key referencing Communication(CommRegistry), relating thermal/power data to communication info if relevant.
An enum (ThermalImagingStatus_enum) describing thermal imaging system health (e.g., Warning, Critical, Normal).
An enum (InsulationStatus_enum) indicating insulation quality (e.g., Fair, Poor, Good).
A DECIMAL(8,3) measuring the heat loss rate in kilowatt-hours (kWh) per some reference time.
An enum (SolarPanelStatus_enum) describing the solar panel status (e.g., Fault, Inactive, Active).
An enum (WindTurbineStatus_enum) indicating turbine operation state (e.g., Fault, Operating, Stopped).
An enum (PowerGridStatus_enum) describing grid connection state (e.g., Connected, Disconnected, Island Mode).
A DECIMAL(5,2) capturing power quality or stability (e.g., 95.50).
An enum (BackupPowerStatus_enum) for backup power system health (e.g., Fault, Active, Standby).
An enum (FuelCellStatus_enum) indicating the fuel cell’s operating state (e.g., Standby, Fault, Operating).
A DOUBLE PRECISION value denoting power output (in watts) from the fuel cell.
A DECIMAL(4,1) describing the fuel cell’s efficiency as a percentage.
A DECIMAL(5,2) measuring the hydrogen supply level as a percentage of capacity.
A DECIMAL(5,2) indicating the oxygen supply level as a percentage of capacity.
An INTEGER foreign key referencing PowerBattery(PowerBattRegistry), connecting thermal/power generation data to battery/power details.

JSONB column. Groups performance data for renewable energy sources, including solar panels and wind turbines.
